significations.body: nervous system (dissociation), spiritual nervous sensitivity, karmic wounds
significations.relationships: saints, mystics, those who inspire detachment

note: Ketu is the south lunar node; it represents past-life mastery, spiritual gifts, and the desire for liberation. Where Ketu sits, the native has already mastered that area in past lives and may feel detachment or disinterest there. It operates through intuition and spiritual insight.

1: Past-life spiritual gifts; strong psychic intuition
2: Detachment from family and wealth; spiritual approach to resources
Past-life mastery of values and material wisdom
3: Detachment from siblings; past-life mastery of communication
Intuitive and spiritually oriented writing or speech
Short journeys have a spiritual purpose
4: Detachment from home; possible foreign settlement
Past-life connection to land and roots
5: Spiritual intelligence; past-life mastery of creativity
Detachment from romantic love; intuitive children
Interest in mantra, meditation, and spiritual creativity
6: Past-life mastery of service and healing
Excellent for spiritual healing and alternative medicine
7: Detachment from partnerships; karmic spouse connection
8: Deep past-life connection to occult and transformation
Intuitive healer; interest in mysticism and death
The most powerful placement for spiritual research
9: Past-life mastery of philosophy and religion
Detachment from dogma; direct spiritual experience
A true seeker beyond organized religion
10: Detachment from career status; work is service
Recognition through spiritual work or unconventional paths
11: Detachment from desires and social gains
Past-life mastery of networks and goals
Gains come unexpectedly; spiritual fulfillment over material
12: The most spiritually powerful placement; moksha path
Past-life mastery of liberation and the unseen
Strong connection to the divine and the hidden
